title: Slack desktop workspace data
whyItMatters: Slack keeps a local copy of every signed-in workspace: message cache, files, drafts and the session itself. It shows which companies the person worked with.
source: Slack Help, update the Slack desktop app: the Linux package stores its data in ~/.config/Slack: https://slack.com/intl/en-gb/help/articles/360048367814-Update-the-Slack-desktop-app
notes: Holds the Chromium profile, IndexedDB caches and downloaded files per workspace. The snap keeps its data under ~/snap/slack/current/.config/Slack and the Flatpak under ~/.var/app/com.slack.Slack/config/Slack.
